notes: hex: the byte stream fed to a parser in one go, followed by >= 100 ms of silence.

frames: structurally valid frames (magic a5 13, header CRC-16/CCITT-FALSE, payload CRC-32/ISO-HDLC, proto_major 1) a direction-agnostic parser finds, responses included. The 492-byte request payload limit is a device rule and shows up only in device_events.

device_events: what the scope parser reports, in order. event = frame | bad_crc | bad_len | bad_version | ascii | ascii_overflow. Dropped input produces no event. The device ignores frames with the RESPONSE flag.
Field values: little-endian; payload layouts per docs/protocol.md section 8.

decim.notes: 1.9 decimation filter: N = 2 * (floor(D / 2) + 1); effective K = 0 for k_req 0, divider 0 or total > 8190, else the largest K <= k_req with 255 * M^K < 2^48; gain M^K; shift S = max(0, bitlen(255 * gain) - 16) + fir; level16[i] = min(65535, round(levels[i] * gain / 2^S)); rate = 200 MSa/s / N (K = 0: 200 MSa/s / (D + 1)); settle_us = ceil((K + 2) * N / 200); ext_shift = round((120 ns + K (N - 1) 2.5 ns) / (N x 5 ns)), halves up, 0 for K = 0. 1.11 FIR (fir_req = SET_DECIM flags bit 3, FPGA 0x1535): fir = 1 when fir_req, K >= 1, N >= 16 and N % 4 == 0; then M = N / 2 (else M = N), settle_us = ceil((K + 10) * N / 200) + 1, ext_shift = round((250 ns + 17.5 N ns + 1.25 K (N - 2) ns) / (N x 5 ns)), halves up.

adc_cal_v3.notes: Calibration data v3 block (protocol 1.12, row 51), sector 708 bytes 128..431, little-endian: u32 magic 'ACAL', u16 version 3, u16 length 304, u16 clock classes 2, u16 0; per channel (CH1, CH2, 144 bytes): u16 pwm[6] (the dc_calibration_offset values it was measured at; ignored unless equal to sector 709's), i16 zero[class][core][range] (class 0 full rate = divider 0 and filtered, 1 gated = legacy divider >= 1; core 0 A = FPGA 0x20/0x22, 1 B = 0x21/0x23; 1/16 code), i16 slope[class][core][range] (Q16 codes per PWM count), u8 noise[class][core][range] (RMS, 1/16 code), u16 gain[class][core] (Q15, 32768 = 1), u8 gain_range (0xFF = never measured), u8 gain_flags (bit 0 carried over), u16 gain_lever (1/16 code); u32 zlib.crc32 of the 300 bytes before it. GET_CAL (1.12) bytes 112..255 carry the same per-channel layout for the requested channel.

diag_layouts.notes: Protocol 1.16 (row 55) stored layouts, little-endian. life: settings sector 709 words 224..255 as bytes (u16 marker 0x11FE, u16 flags (bit 0 session open), u32 power_on, u32 operating minutes, u16 restart flags (bit 0 stored), u16 restarts, u16 exception type, u16 0, u32 power_on of the record, u32 exception LR, SPSR, exception SP, reset LR, reset SP, reset CPSR, fault status, fault address, operating minutes at the record, u32 0). prov: sector 708 bytes 432..487 (u32 'APRV', u16 version 1, u16 length 56, u32 build, char[16] version, u16 FPGA word, u8 what (bit 0 CH1 zeros, 1 CH1 gains, 2 CH2 zeros, 3 CH2 gains), u8 rtc, u32 uptime_ms, u32 power_on, u32 minutes, u8[6] time, u16 0, u32 zlib.crc32 of the 52 bytes before). ident: the image identity record linked last in fw 0.2.52+ (u32 'FWID', u32 '1013', char[16] version, u32 build, u8[6] commit time, u8 proto_major, u8 proto_minor).

decim_peak.notes: 1.26 peak detect (FPGA 0x153C, fw-c6), checked against pc_decim.c by decim_check --peak / --peak-corr. cases: divider total k_req fir_req -> peak (1 = the record is { max, min } words), k (1), n (the window 2 (floor(D / 2) + 1)), why (0; 2 at divider 0, 3 over 8190 samples: legacy record, the FIR request dropped), status (the mode byte 0x81), shift_byte (0xC0: bit 7 peak active, bit 6 peak written, S 0), cmd56 (0x56 = 2), rate 200 MSa/s / N, settle_us = ceil(11 N / 200) + 1, ext_shift = round((120 ns + (N - 1) 2.5 ns + 40 ns) / (N x 5 ns)) (the K = 1 boxcar's latency with the capture stages). corr: gain_a gain_b off_a off_b (Q16, GET_CAL 92..107 at divider 0: the full clock class) -> gain = round((gain_a + gain_b) / 2), off = (off_a + off_b) / 2 (C division); codes = clamp((raw x gain + off + 2^15) >> 16) for raws, mids = clamp(((min + max) gain + 2 off + 2^16) >> 17) for pairs (the processed trace's sample), level = the raw code whose corrected value is the level (0x55 = level << 8; 0 when the level is at or below the offset), overload = (min == 0) | (max == 255 ? 0xFE) for pairs.

seq.notes: 1.17 sequencer (FPGA 0x1536), checked against pc_seq.c by seq_check (check_vectors.py --seq-checker). fit: args mode flags m count n pre_words total_words wide -> fit code (0 ok, 1 mode, 2 flags, 3 m, 4 count, 5 total, 6 pre, 7 N), max count, table slots, 0x57, 0x58, 0x5A. Segments: m 5..12, count <= 8192 >> m, total + 2 <= 2^m, pre < total; averaging: N 1..65536 (legacy <= 257), total <= 2046, count x total <= 2048. hold: ns -> 5 ns units, rounded up. entry: u64 -> timestamp (bits 39..0), offset (52..40), triggered (53), valid (63). segw: m s offset pre j -> sample memory word s 2^m + ((offset - pre + j) mod 2^m). plan (UI averaging): total pre divider -> N (largest power of two 2..64 with N (record + dead) <= 40 ms, word = 10 (D + 1) ns, dead = total x 5 + 40 + (2 + pre) word + 100 ns; 0 = software) and the run in us, rounded up. avg: sum c gain off -> corrected code of the mean: m8 = floor((sum x 256 + floor(c / 2)) / c), code = clamp((m8 x gain + off x 256 + 2^23) >> 24, 0, 255).

vectors.name: host_resp_get_info_1_26
vectors.description: GET_INFO response, protocol 1.26 (80 bytes): FPGA 0x153C, caps add HOLDOFF (2), TRIG_TYPES (20), PEAK_DETECT (21), COUNTER (22) = 0x7FEC4F

vectors.name: host_resp_e_unsupported_fpga_mismatch_1_26
vectors.description: E_UNSUPPORTED detail 1 with the 1.26 mismatch text (the scope runs another word than 0x153C)

vectors.name: host_req_set_trigger2_pulse_longer
vectors.description: SET_TRIGGER2 0x0219 (24 bytes): type 1 pulse width, polarity 0 positive pulse, flags LONGER, source CH1, N 1500 samples (15 us at 1 MSa/s legacy words), H 0, level 140, level2 0, hold-off 0

vectors.name: host_req_set_trigger2_nth_edge
vectors.description: SET_TRIGGER2: type 2 Nth edge, polarity 1 falling edges counted, source CH2, N 3, idle H 20000 samples, level 128

vectors.name: host_req_set_trigger2_timeout_ext
vectors.description: SET_TRIGGER2: type 3 timeout, polarity 1 held low, source EXT, N 200000 x 5 ns = 1 ms, level 0

vectors.name: host_req_set_trigger2_edge_holdoff
vectors.description: SET_TRIGGER2: type 0 edge rising (N, H 0), CH1, level 128, hold-off 500 000 x 5 ns = 2.5 ms (the firmware writes 0x66 with it: the next ARM clears a running hold-off)

vectors.name: host_resp_get_trigger_1_26_pulse
vectors.description: GET_TRIGGER response, protocol 1.26 (52 bytes): the 28-byte TRIGGER (12 hold-off 500000 units) then the SET_TRIGGER2 block at 28..51 (pulse width longer than 1500, level 140, hold-off 500000)

vectors.name: host_resp_get_status_1_26_armed
vectors.description: GET_STATUS response, protocol 1.26 (52 bytes): ARMED (run_state SINGLE), features 0x7FF, 48 0x37 = 0x10 hold-off running, 49 0x34 = 0x22 counting + type 2 Nth edge, 50 edges still to count 2

vectors.name: host_req_get_counter_read
vectors.description: GET_COUNTER 0x0213 request (8 bytes): what 0 = read the snapshot (the other fields ignored)

vectors.name: host_req_get_counter_config
vectors.description: GET_COUNTER request: what 1 = configure then read: gate 3 (1 s), source 2 (CH2), level 140, hysteresis 6

vectors.name: host_resp_get_counter
vectors.description: GET_COUNTER response (24 bytes): flags NEW|VALID, seq 17, gate 2 (100 ms), source 0 (the trigger source, CH1), E 1000, T 20 000 000 clocks, W 4 000 000 (10.000000 kHz, duty 20 %), min 112, max 147, level 128, hysteresis 6, freq_mHz 10 000 000

vectors.name: host_req_set_decim_peak
vectors.description: SET_DECIM filter 4 = peak detect (flags 0)

vectors.name: host_resp_get_decim_peak
vectors.description: GET_DECIM / SET_DECIM response (36 bytes) with peak detect at divider 199: filter 4, next mode 0x81 (16-bit, K 1), shift byte 0xC0 (bit 7 peak active, bit 6 peak written, S 0), N 200, gain 1, 1 MSa/s, features 0x7FF (bits 8-10 TRIG_TYPES / PEAK / COUNTER)

vectors.name: host_req_read_raw_peak
vectors.description: READ_RAW CH1 both cores, addr_mode 1 (capture-relative), layout 3 = peak pairs, 4 words

vectors.name: host_resp_read_raw_peak
vectors.description: READ_RAW response, layout 3: per channel 4 minima (100 101 90 102) then 4 maxima (140 141 170 139)

vectors.name: host_resp_get_capture_info_1_26_peak
vectors.description: GET_CAPTURE_INFO response (112 bytes) of a peak-detect host capture at divider 199 with a pulse-width trigger: byte 68 mode 0x81, 69 shift byte 0xC0, 72 N 200, 76 run mode 0 (a single capture), 79 = 0x03 (bit 0 16-bit records, bit 1 peak), 96 type 1, 97 flags LONGER, 100 N 1500, 104 H 0, 108 hold-off 500000
